items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: I called him Kid Nicholas. We had a... He on cornet. I was on trombone.

ctx.x: He had a little trombone player. I've come up wrong in my class. I find he was pretty good. Clayton will tell us about him when we talk to you. Yeah.

Sure can know his name. Yeah. Anything else you'd like to tell about the bands you played with? I play with another band up there. We used to call him Kid Nicholas. We called him Wooden Jones. Oh, yes. That guy was like a mule. That guy could take a brass band out on the street by himself. Powerful.
